# deevnet_dns_record (Resource)

A name in the tenant's zone, with its PTR.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A second name for a workload, with its PTR.
resource "deevnet_dns_record" "api" {
  tenant  = deevnet_tenant.this.name
  name    = "api"
  address = deevnet_workload.web.address
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) An address in the tenant's own subnet.
- `name` (String) A DNS label under the tenant's zone.
- `tenant` (String) The tenant this record belongs to: the `name` of a `deevnet_tenant`.

### Read-Only

- `fqdn` (String) The published name.
- `present` (Boolean) Whether the API still holds this name.
